{{Top|leg}}
'''Songsteel''' was an extraordinarily light and luminescent silver metal, used in masterwork swords and staves. The metal was reserved only for the most exquisite of weapons, and was extremely tedious to forge and shape. Songsteel was highly resistant to [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] strikes in a manner similar to [[Phrik/Legends|phrik]] and [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]], as shown by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Darrus Jeht/Legends|Darrus Jeht]] who wielded a [[songsteel sword]] in a practice [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]] against the Jedi Masters [[Lanius Qel-Bertuk]] and [[Devan For'deschel]],<ref name="The Duel">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20040610|text=The Duel|int=The Duel (article)}}</ref> successfully deflecting and blocking their combined lightsaber attacks with his own Songsteel blade.

The [[Master in Violet]] owned a fighting staff that had been made from a songsteel shard, and she fought with the weapon when the [[Five Masters Academy]] fell under attack from an unidentified opponent.<ref name="Faded Colors">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/lf20060202FadedColors|text=Faded Colors|int=Faded Colors}}</ref>

During the [[Confederation Rock Rush]], the [[Heroes of Cularin]] discovered deposits of songsteel on an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] in the [[Cularin asteroid belt]].<ref name="Philanthropy">{{LivingForce|Below the Belt: Philanthropy}}</ref>
